name: google/oss-fuzz
description: Google's continuous fuzzing service for open source software, integrating AFL++, libFuzzer, and Honggfuzz to find vulnerabilities at scale; has reported over 13,000 vulnerabilities across 1,000+ projects.
score_rationale: Essential infrastructure for open-source security with 12k stars, backing the entire OSS fuzzing ecosystem, actively maintained through 2026.
